blocks.title: Run the official Cloudflare workflow from your project
blocks.description: Help Vetta choose current Wrangler commands, configuration and safe deployment steps without relying on stale syntax.

showcase.user_prompt: Add an R2 binding to this Worker, update its types, test locally and prepare a deployment.
showcase.assistant_reply: I’ll inspect the project and its package manager, update the existing configuration, verify locally, and ask before any live deployment.

items.title: Respect the project
items.description: Use the repository's package manager and project-local Wrangler version instead of forcing a global installation.

items.title: Manage Cloudflare resources
items.description: Work with Workers, KV, R2, D1, Queues, Workflows and other supported developer services.

items.title: Keep secrets out of chat
items.description: Use Wrangler's protected secret flows and avoid logging or hardcoding credentials.

items.title: Open a Cloudflare project
items.description: Work from the project root so Vetta can inspect package and Wrangler configuration.

items.title: Describe the operation
items.description: Ask to develop locally, configure a binding, inspect logs or prepare a deployment.

items.title: Approve live changes
items.description: Review commands and deployment targets before actions that affect your Cloudflare account.

blocks.title: Wrangler is installed per project
blocks.content: This package does not install a global CLI. If Wrangler is missing, Vetta follows the project's package-manager conventions and Cloudflare's project-local installation guidance. Node.js and network access may be required.
